attributes.projectbenefitstatement: This project replaces the bridges at the I-25 and Speer Boulevard and 23rd Avenue interchanges and constructs associated braided ramps and connector roads. The bridges have very low clearance and substandard ramp spacing cause safety and congestion issues.
